sections.treatment_HF_aortic_stenosis: Aortic valve intervention (TAVI or SAVR) is recommended in patients with HF and severe high-gradient aortic stenosis to reduce mortality and improve symptoms; choice between TAVI and SAVR by Heart Team.
sections.treatment_HF_diabetes: SGLT2 inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin) are recommended in patients with T2DM at risk of CV events to reduce hospitalizations for HF, major CV events, end-stage renal dysfunction and CV death; SGLT2 inhibitors also recommended in patients with T2DM and HFrEF to reduce HF and CV death. Thiazolidinediones not recommended in HF.
sections.treatment_HF_iron_deficiency: All patients with HF should be periodically screened for anaemia and iron deficiency with full blood count, serum ferritin concentration and TSAT; treat iron deficiency per guidance; erythropoiesis-stimulating agents not recommended for HF anaemia absent other indications.
sections.treatment_HF_sleep_apnoea: Adaptive servo-ventilation is not recommended in patients with HFrEF and predominant central sleep apnoea due to increased all-cause and CV mortality.
sections.treatment_HF_arthritis: NSAIDs or COX-2 inhibitors are not recommended in patients with HF due to increased risk of HF worsening and hospitalization.
sections.treatment_HF_cancer: Cancer patients at increased risk for cardiotoxicity should undergo CV evaluation prior to anti-cancer therapy; consider cardio-oncology involvement for prior cardiotoxicity or exposure to cardiotoxic agents.
sections.treatment_HF_amyloidosis: Tafamidis is recommended in patients with genetically proven hATTR cardiac amyloidosis (hATTR-CA) with NYHA class I-II symptoms to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalization and mortality; tafamidis is also recommended in wtTTR-CA with NYHA class I-II to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalization and mortality.
sections.diagnosis_chronic_HF: Recommended diagnostic tests include BNP/NT-proBNP, 12-lead ECG, transthoracic echocardiography, chest radiography, routine blood tests (full blood count, urea and electrolytes, thyroid function, fasting glucose, HbA1c, lipids, iron studies including TSAT and ferritin). Cardiac MRI is recommended for myocardial structure assessment when echo is suboptimal and for characterization in suspected infiltrative disease (eg, Fabry, amyloid). Coronary angiography when angina or consideration of revascularization.
sections.treatment_HFrEF: ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers, MRAs, and SGLT2 inhibitors are recommended to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death in HFrEF. ARNI (sacubitril/valsartan) recommended as replacement for ACE-I in patients with persistent symptoms. Diuretics recommended for congestion symptom relief. ICD recommended for selected patients to reduce sudden death; CRT recommended in selected patients with wide QRS and LBBB or pacing indications.
sections.device_therapy: ICD and CRT recommendations provided with class/level guidance based on LVEF, symptomatic status, QRS duration/morphology and timing post-MI.

genes.context: Guideline states that tafamidis is recommended in patients with genetic testing–proven hATTR-CA and in patients with wtTTR-CA with NYHA class I–II symptoms to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalisation and mortality.
